data.one_liner: A Flutter button widget that becomes enabled after a designated time interval.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable timer button widget that stays disabled or counts down for a specified number of seconds before allowing user interaction. Supports multiple built-in button styles like ElevatedButton and TextButton, as well as a custom builder.
use_when: You need a resend OTP button with a cooldown timer.
You want to force users to wait before accepting terms or clicking an action button.
avoid_when: You need complex state management architectures.
You require custom animations outside the standard countdown display.
strengths: Supports multiple button types (Elevated, Text, Outline, Custom).
Easy to set up with duration and color configuration.
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific use-case widget.
Not documented for complex customized timer state outside built-in properties.
